SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover, t.post_count, t.follow_count, t.status, t.created_time FROM portal_topic t WHERE t.status = 'active'
AND (t.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR t.description LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND t.name LIKE CONCAT(#{query.initial}, '%')
ORDER BY t.follow_count DESC, t.created_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover, t.post_count, t.follow_count, t.status, t.created_time FROM portal_topic t WHERE t.status = 'active' ORDER BY t.follow_count DESC, t.post_count DESC, t.created_time DESC
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover, t.post_count, t.follow_count, t.status, t.created_time FROM portal_topic t WHERE t.slug = #{slug}
SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover, t.post_count, t.follow_count, t.status, t.created_time FROM portal_topic t WHERE t.id = #{id}

SELECT a.id, a.title, a.cover, a.excerpt, a.author_id, a.views, a.likes, a.create_time, pu.nickname AS author_name, pu.avatar AS author_avatar FROM portal_article a INNER JOIN portal_entity_tag et ON et.entity_id = a.id AND et.entity_type = 'article' INNER JOIN portal_tag tg ON tg.id = et.tag_id AND tg.name = #{topicName} LEFT JOIN portal_user pu ON pu.id = a.author_id WHERE a.status = 'published' ORDER BY a.create_time DESC

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.slug, t.description, t.cover, t.post_count, t.follow_count, t.status, t.created_time FROM portal_topic t
